sentences.text: George Andrew Romero -LRB- -LSB- rə 'm ɛroʊ -RSB- born February 4 , 1940 -RRB- is an American-Canadian filmmaker and editor , best known for his series of gruesome and satirical horror films about an imagined zombie apocalypse , beginning with Night of the Living Dead and notably continuing on with Dawn of the Dead and Day of the Dead .	editor	film editing	filmmaker	filmmaker	series	Night of the Living Dead (film series)	zombie	zombie	apocalypse	Apocalyptic and post-apocalyptic fiction	Night of the Living Dead	Night of the Living Dead	Dawn of the Dead	Dawn of the Dead (1978 film)	Day of the Dead	Day of the Dead (1985 film)
